reasons: CS4236 requires CS2107 as a prerequisite, but CS2107 is not in the list of courses the student must take.
CS3219 requires YSC3232 or CS2103/CS2103T/CS2103DE/CS2113T/CS2113. The student has completed CS2103T, so this prerequisite is satisfied.
CS2102 requires CS2030S (completed) and CS2040S (completed) and (CS1231 or MA1100 or MA1100T or CS1231S). The student has completed CS1231S, so this prerequisite is satisfied.
CS2105 requires YSC2229 or CS2040S (completed). Prerequisite satisfied.
The critical blocker is CS4236's prerequisite CS2107. Since CS2107 is not listed as a required course for the student to take, it cannot be planned. Therefore, CS4236 cannot be taken.

Even if CS2107 were taken, the constraint 'CS2105 and CS4236 must be in the same semester' and 'CS3219 and CS4236 must be in the same semester' forces CS2105, CS3219, and CS4236 into one semester. CS4236 is fixed in Sem 7. So Sem 7 would contain CS2105, CS3219, CS4236. This is 12 MC. However, without CS2107, CS4236 is ineligible.
